connector.name: Litmus
connector.registryDescription: Grade MCP servers A to F with the open behavioral litmus. npm: full toolset; hosted: lookups only.
connector.summary: Hosted at polygraph.so over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package litmus. No credential is declared, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the polygraphso account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: No credential is declared in the registry record. A hosted endpoint may still apply its own rate limits or sign in step.
